Folks — draft notes for the playbook below (I will produce a polished PDF for FinBank):

Customer log access options:
- Self-service export (recommended): Tenant admins can request exports of event slices (time window + event types) via the Console. Exports are delivered to a customer S3 bucket (preconfigured) or via secure transfer (SFTP). Typical SLA: 24 hours for exports <= 72h of data; 48 hours for larger windows.
- Support-assisted export: For ad-hoc requests where customer cannot access console. Requires ticket + proof of authorization. SLA: 48–72 hours.
- Read-only streaming: For customers on Redwood Dedicated or Private, we support a tenant-specific event stream (Kafka or secure syslog) with read-only credentials. This requires network setup and an onboarding window (2–4 weeks).

Retention policy (defaults):
- Authentication events: 365 days
- Model inference events (per-request logs): 90 days default, configurable up to 548 days (18 months) for enterprise customers
- Admin / configuration changes: 540 days
- Billing events: 7 years (for audit & finance)

Notes / constraints:
- Exports redact PII by default; customers can request full-detail exports under contractual terms and DPA addenda.
- For Private deployments, retention is governed by the customer's on-prem policy; Redwood provides the tooling and playbook.

Attachments to include in the packet: retention matrix, a sanitized sample JSONL, and the playbook PDF.

Marissa
Product Security Manager
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>

Subject: SIG evidence packet and tenant access playbook (FinBank)

Hi Alice — attaching the packet we discussed. High level summary below and links to the artifacts in our secure drive.

What we sent:
- redwood-sig-retention-matrix.csv — maps event classes to default retention and configurable options by tier.
- audit-log-sample-202611.jsonl.gz — 10k-line sanitized sample showing fields: timestamp, tenant_id, request_id, user_id (hashed), action, model_id, latency_ms, region, ip (redacted).
- tenant-access-playbook-v1.pdf — step-by-step for exports, streaming, authorization checks, and escalation path.

Key items for FinBank:
- Live streaming of tenant events is available for Dedicated/Private customers only. For hosted customers we provide exports and near-real-time push to customer S3.
- SLA for ad-hoc exports: 24–72 hours depending on window size; dedicated customers can negotiate shorter windows in their contract.
- We maintain an audit trail of export requests and include the requester identity in exported metadata.

- For the read-only streaming option, can you confirm whether Kujira (our SIEM) can consume the Kafka topic using mTLS? Any sample connector notes would help.
- For hosted customers, is there an option to enable near-real-time Egress to customer-managed Kinesis or Pub/Sub? We saw S3 but need push to streaming targets.
- Can you provide the export request audit log schema (fields included) so we can validate chain-of-custody in our own workflows?

If you can answer those three items in the morning, procurement will proceed with final contract redlines. Otherwise we may need to ask for a short extension.

Thanks — Alice
